spapi.//orders_report_max_age_years: GET_FLAT_FILE_ALL_ORDERS_* purchase-date floor. Chunks older than this come back DONE with 0 rows. Jan–Jul 2024 is past this wall as of 2026-08; do not poll them.
spapi.//inventory_ledger_days: Daily inventory-ledger window. Physical nexus depends on this feed, so the window is wider than strictly needed: Amazon can restate ledger rows for several days, and a wider window re-upserts them rather than missing them. Upsert-only — a narrow or wide window never deletes older events.
spapi.//inventory_ledger_backfill_days: Weekly deeper re-pull, for ledger rows Amazon settled after the daily window had moved on. Also upsert-only.

ads.//sku_economics_min_date: Seller Central SKU Economics exports only retain from this month. Earlier ad months need Ads Console campaign CSV or another source — not SKU Economics.
ads.//campaign_chunk_days: SP campaign pull uses 7-day chunks, not one 30-day report. Still clamped to max_chunk_days.
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_chunk_days: SB/SD use 1-day chunks. A single 7-day SB/SD report that times out at 900s used to wipe the whole window (2026-08-25: SB+SD $0, SP kept → Aug 23–24 SP-only vs console). One-day chunks keep prior days when one report stalls.
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_daily_days: Nightly SB/SD window. Nightly SP uses the same 7d range (ads_campaigns_sync days=7). After a partial, ads-heal retries SB/SD only.
ads.//campaign_sb_sd_backfill_days: Sunday 90d backfill still covers SP for long trends. SB/SD stay on a short window so 03:00 cannot still hold the lock at 05:00.
